text:
mara: Heads-up: tonight's egress-hardening at 01:00 UTC will default infra subnets (10.210.0.0/16) to deny. I'm worried new GPU nodes in usw2 will not reach KMS and fail disk decrypt during boot. Can we gate the change?

jon: Which CL is that? link?

security-oncall: CL 7321 - flips egress to deny-by-default and only allows a small operator CIDR set. No KMS vpce or NAT EIP entries included.

luis: If KMS calls are blocked we see `KMS AccessDenied` or `InvalidCiphertextException` in cloud-init and the node keeps retrying attach/decrypt. It prevents join and wastes warm-pool capacity. We saw this in a dry-run.

sre-ops-bot: ALERT: 2026-01-05T00:45:10Z - 6 gpu nodes in usw2 reported decrypt errors in dry-run. Example log: "cloud-init: ERROR: volume_decrypt: InvalidCiphertextException for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd1234"

mara: Quick options: (A) add KMS VPC endpoint IDs (vpce-0d1e2f) to allowlist, (B) carve out warm-pool subnets from default deny, or (C) whitelist NAT GW EIPs as a temporary fallback. Long-term we want FQDN-based egress via proxy.

jon: Firewall is CIDR-only for this appliance, right? FQDN requires proxy changes.

security-oncall: Correct. Proxy FQDN changes aren't in scope for tonight. Fast path: hotfix to CL 7321 adding vpce allow and NAT EIP fallback + add a smoke test. I'll put a hold on the rollout until hotfix merges.

mara: I'll open hotfix CL 7324 and add a runbook snippet: 1) from warm-pool subnet curl https://kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com, 2) run `aws kms decrypt` with test blob, 3) attempt attach of small encrypted EBS and verify decrypt within 5m.

luis: Also add a short alert: `gpu.node.decrypt.failed > 0 for 5m` -> page oncall and trigger infra-rollout pause webhook.

jon: Acknowledged. Release window moved to held; rollback window 01:15 UTC. Keep me posted.

mara: Hotfix CL 7324 opened. Will update thread when smoke passes and CL is merged.

sre-ops-bot: Follow-ups created: runbook CL 7330, hotfix CL 7324, alert CL 7331."
